messages:
Carlos (Support): heads-up — multiple customers reporting 502/504s against hosted API starting ~10:12. getting an escalation ticket from payments and a couple of PLG signups. likely related to a recent rollout?
Maya (SRE): :eyes: i'm seeing a clear spike in gateway 5xx rate around 10:11 in our prod cluster. P50/P95 latency also increased.
Drew (Infra): i kicked a small canary at 10:10 to test prefetch changes — canary config set `prefetch_window=0` to try to lower tail latency. weight was 5%.
Ava (Eng): I intended that selector to target staging only but used the wrong label key. possible selector mismatch — canary may have applied to a subset of prod hosts.
Carlos (Support): repro from customers: single POST to /v1/generate with a 1k prompt -> request hangs ~8s and returns 504. example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-1","prompt":"..."}'`
Maya (SRE): digging through worker logs — lots of `kvcache: prefix lookup timeout` and `batcher: queue full` originating from the canary-tagged pods. gateway upstream errors show `502` from inference workers.
Drew (Infra): logs (snippet):
```
ERROR request_id=3f2a kvcache: lookup timeout after 300ms
WARN batcher: overflow on enqueue id=3f2a size=64
ERROR worker: downstream proxy returned 502
```
Maya (SRE): agree this looks like a prefetch/batching regression causing backpressure -> upstream 502s and gateway 504s.
Carlos (Support): customers are asking for ETA. ops-oncall, can we mitigate now?
ops-oncall: starting rollback of canary config and reducing traffic weight to 0. running `/scripts/rollout rollback --id=canary-2026-03-18-10-10` now.
deploy-bot: rollback started by ops-oncall at 10:25 UTC — job id rb-1717773333-1, status: in_progress
Ava (Eng): applying hotfix: update selector to `env:staging` (correct) and restore `prefetch_window=128` for prod variant. pushing patch to the config-store.
Drew (Infra): verifying rollout: removing canary tag from 12 nodes and draining traffic.
Maya (SRE): monitoring — error rate dropped ~60% within 2 minutes of rollback start, now down ~85% after full rollback (3m). P95 latency returning to baseline.
Carlos (Support): sending interim update to customers: root cause suspected mis-scoped canary that toggled prefetch behavior in prod, rollback in progress. will follow up when stable.
Ava (Eng): follow-up: we'll add a validation step to prevent selector-key typos and a smoke test that exercises small-batch paths under canary before any traffic cut.
Drew (Infra): filing a post-deploy checklist item: `validate-selector` gate + canary traffic cap enforcement.
Maya (SRE): action items: 1) confirm all affected customers recovered, 2) capture traces for the offending window, 3) postmortem draft.
Carlos (Support): noted — i will open tickets and tag customers, attach repro steps and the rollback summary.
ops-oncall: rollback completed at 10:29 UTC, status: success.
deploy-bot: rollback job rb-1717773333-1 finished: success
Maya (SRE): closing triage for now, moving to postmortem channel. thanks everyone for quick response :thumbsup:
Carlos (Support): will follow up with affected accounts and close out escalation once confirmed stable.
